summary: Iteration 12 fully verified. Backend (7/7 pytest) — bank-name expansion returns friendly list on Bosch KGN56LB42I PDP endpoint; POST /api/offers/admin/create accepts extended_warranty and returns 200 with whatsapp_message; brand-wide warranty appears as a 2nd offer on Bosch PDP alongside the SKU offer; PUT /api/offers/admin/{id} accepts terms/is_active/offer_type. Frontend admin — Add Offer modal opens, creates extended_warranty offer visible in table with Extended Warranty badge, edit re-opens pre-filled, delete cleans up. PDP shows friendly bank list 'HDFC, ICICI, Axis, SBI, Kotak, American Express, Bank of Baroda, Yes Bank, IndusInd, IDFC First, RBL' — no 'All Banks' literal. 442 total offers preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: OfferUpdate model now includes offer_type/terms/tenure — good. Consider validating offer_type against OFFER_TYPES whitelist in PUT (currently accepts any string).
_expand_bank_names covers 'all banks', 'any bank', 'all cards', 'any card'. Consider also handling 'all major banks' / 'all credit cards' if source data uses those.
OfferEditModal writes state.offer.categories/product_ids as comma-joined strings; on save it splits — good UX. But no client-side validation for amount_type=percentage exceeding 100%.
Carried over from prior iter: `_build_whatsapp_link` computes `encoded` variable but discards it in current form (harmless).
Row-based extractor uses eligible_banks_default from legend row — for Bosch that's 'All Banks' which is now expanded server-side. Works fine.
seed_data_creation: Test created 'TEST_UI Warranty' offer via UI and 'TEST 3-year Extended Warranty' via API. Both deleted at end of test run. DB still holds 442 Bosch offers (unchanged).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 iteration-12 asks verified live on prod URL. Bosch KGN56LB42I PDP shows 'Eligible Bank Cards: HDFC, ICICI, Axis, SBI, Kotak, American Express, Bank of Baroda, Yes Bank, IndusInd, IDFC First, RBL'. Admin /admin/offers has functional Add Offer button (data-testid=add-offer-btn) opening OfferEditModal (data-testid=offer-edit-modal) with type select (offer-type-select), title (offer-title-input), banks (offer-banks-input), save (offer-save-btn) and per-row edit buttons (offer-edit-{id}). Extended Warranty type is rendered with indigo Shield badge on both admin table and PDP OffersDisplay. 442 Bosch offers still loaded.
